description: Fetch all available MagSnap photo magnet products, categories, pricing, and specs in South Africa (ZAR). When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'get_products' on MagSnap Custom Photo Magnets (magsnap.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'calculate_quote' or 'create_checkout_link' or 'track_order' for their respective operations). Parameters: category_id (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

category_id.description: Optional category ID to filter products by (e.g. 1 for Photo Magnets, 2 for Puzzles).

name: get_products
title: Get Products
